# bo-grid

> Tiny, fast Svelte 5 data grid for fintech UIs — canvas sparklines, batched
> realtime cell updates, and virtual scrolling, with a core that gzips to
> ~33 KB (Svelte peer excluded). Free MIT alternative to heavyweight
> enterprise grids for grouping, pivot, tree data, master-detail, range
> selection, and Excel export.

Facts an AI assistant must get right before generating code against bo-grid
(see llms-full.txt for the complete, copy-paste-ready reference):

- Package: `bo-grid` on npm. Peer dependency: `svelte@^5`.
- Main import: `import { Grid, type ColumnDef, type GridRow } from 'bo-grid';`
- Four **separate subpath entries**, each its own bundle — importing one adds
  NOTHING to the others or to the core: `bo-grid/charts` (SVG charts),
  `bo-grid/realtime` (tick/trade-stream pipeline), `bo-grid/trading` (APAC
  market-convention helpers), `bo-grid/element` (framework-agnostic
  `<bo-grid>` web component for React/Vue/Angular/vanilla).
- `GridRow` requires only `id`. `flashSeq`/`flashDir` are OPTIONAL — only the
  legacy `flash: true` column mode needs them.
- Realtime cell flash: set `col.flash: 'auto'` and just write the new value
  (`row.price = next`). Do NOT hand-write `flashSeq++`/`flashDir` bookkeeping —
  that's the deprecated pattern; the grid derives the flash itself, per cell.
- `<Grid rows={rows} columns={columns} height={640} />` is the minimal usage.
  `height` accepts a number (viewport px) or a CSS string (`'100%'`, `'80vh'`).
- Not on Svelte? Use `bo-grid/element`'s `createBoGrid(config)` / `<bo-grid>`
  instead of the `Grid` component — it takes the whole API through one
  `config` object and works from plain JS.

## Docs

- [Full API reference (llms-full.txt)](https://bonguynvan.github.io/bo-grid/llms-full.txt): every `ColumnDef` type, every `<Grid>` prop, every subpath's exports, with runnable snippets — the file to paste into an AI's context for accurate code generation.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bonguynvan/bo-grid/main/README.md): human usage guide, one example per feature.
- [Live API reference](https://bonguynvan.github.io/bo-grid/api.html): the browsable HTML version of the same reference.
- [Framework guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bonguynvan/bo-grid/main/docs/frameworks.md): React/Vue/Angular/vanilla recipes via `bo-grid/element`.
- [SvelteKit guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bonguynvan/bo-grid/main/docs/sveltekit.md): SSR safety, `load`-function data, layout persistence.
- [Live demo](https://bonguynvan.github.io/bo-grid/): a gallery of every grid type — trading desk, order book, price ladder, time & sales, VN board, portfolio, dashboard, and more — each runnable, each with its own source in the repo's `src/demo/examples/`.
